name: CATALYST_SEARCH_TIER_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: CATALYST_SEARCH_TIER_20261107 — the overnight catalyst lane staged no momentum_catalyst row
after 2026-10-29 while its runs kept reporting candidates 4 / catalyst_confirmed 0 / search_errors 0.
Measured on the live SearXNG instance 2026-11-07: the fallback query asked categories=news with
time_range=day and engines=google news,bing news,duckduckgo. time_range=day returns 0 results for
EVERY category on this instance (general 33 results collapses to 0), and the allowlist named a
CAPTCHA-suspended engine, an engine with a parse error, and duckduckgo, which is not a news engine
(duckduckgo news is). SearXNG answers HTTP 200 with results [] and unresponsive_engines populated
when every engine fails, and the old code read that as a quiet market.
The gate pins: the request asks for the news category with no time window and no engine allowlist;
a news tier that reports failed engines falls back once to the instance's whole engine set; a news
tier that answers nothing with NO failed engine is an honest empty and costs exactly one request
(the 2026-10-10 legacy contract); nothing from either tier while every enabled engine is
unresponsive returns the error row the lane's accuracy gate already reads, so a dead tier becomes
search_errors rather than a silent zero; a failed news request still lets the general tier answer;
and an unreadable /config never invents a dead tier.
Hermetic: a fake urlopen answering /config and the search tiers, stubbed routing engine and env
loader, synthetic symbol. No network, no database, no credential.
